title: ProjectE gate_receipt — a gate closes on a machine-readable receipt, never on an LLM saying PASS

schema_version.$comment: Canonical field. The legacy 'schema' field is a read-only alias; a missing field is never inferred and a conflict is ERROR.

verdict.$comment: Only exit 0 + effective GREEN opens a gate. Exit 1 = RED/NO_COVERAGE/INVALID_METRIC/STALE; exit 2 = contract or runtime error.

argv.$comment: Exact argv. For kicad-cli ERC/DRC gates this MUST include --exit-code-violations, otherwise violations never reach the exit code and the gate emits a false PASS.

inputs.$comment: The next phase does not open until each input sha256 still matches the current artifact hash. This closes the 'gate passed, then the file changed' silent failure.

parsed_metrics.$comment: Every leaf path must bind to a complete semantic entry. Missing, extra or inline+ref conflicting mappings are INVALID_METRIC. A metric leaf is only a finite JSON number (bool excluded).

blockers.$comment: ALIGNED WITH THE VALIDATOR 2026-08-10, in two ways it was wrong before. (1) Items are OBJECTS carrying code+message, not bare strings: tools/scripts/gate_receipt.py::validate_blockers requires both, and a blocker with no code cannot enter reason_codes. (2) `null` is no longer permitted. It used to be, and a literal null made the validator raise TypeError and exit 2 with a traceback instead of reporting the ERROR it had already recorded - a gate that dies is not a gate that said no. The validator is now null-safe as well, but publishing the null form here would keep inviting the shape it refuses. An empty array is how a receipt says 'no blockers'.

path.$comment: Must stay inside --root. '../' and absolute path escapes are ERROR; there is no external allowlist in this version.

semantics.$comment: ALIGNED WITH THE VALIDATOR 2026-08-10. This block previously required `metric_definition` and `sampling_step_mm` with `additionalProperties: false`, while tools/scripts/gate_receipt.py (SEMANTIC_FIELDS) requires `definition` and `sampling_step`. No single document satisfied both: a receipt written against this published schema was rejected by the validator with INCOMPLETE_METRIC_SEMANTICS, and one written for the validator was rejected here. Measured while building cad_asset_qualification. The EXECUTABLE side wins, because it is the one that actually closes a gate - a schema no passing receipt can satisfy is documentation, not a contract. `metric_definition` is kept as an accepted alias so existing receipts are not orphaned, but `definition` is what the validator reads.

metric_definition.$comment: Legacy spelling. Accepted, but NOT read by tools/scripts/gate_receipt.py; publish `definition` as well or the entry is incomplete.

distance_semantics.$comment: Presenting centerline as edge-gap is INVALID_METRIC.

sampling_step.$comment: Required by the validator and never absent: an unsampled metric is not a measured one. Use `not_applicable` when the metric has no spatial sampling.

geometry_model.$comment: Presenting a chord result as arc-aware, or parallelism_coverage as impedance/SI, is INVALID_METRIC.

semantics_ref.$comment: An external semantic ref is ONLY this object. The hash-bound JSON must supply the same metric_id and a complete semantics object, or the gate does not open.

scanned.$comment: scanned=0 on a mandatory gate is NO_COVERAGE and turns the combined gate RED unless explicitly marked advisory.

per_metric.$comment: If present it must cover every metric leaf exactly, and the same invariant holds per row.

coverage.$comment: scanned <= eligible and scanned + excluded == eligible. Inconsistency is INVALID_COVERAGE/RED.

child.$comment: A parent cannot be GREEN when a mandatory child hash/verdict is stale or the child is RED/INVALID/STALE.

fault_injection.$comment: An A-level check is not PASS without hash-bound fixture, receipt-bound baseline, a different injected hash, exact command/exit and expected/observed failure IDs bound to parsed metric leaves.

atomic.$comment: A GREEN promotion must carry atomic proof (atomic: true or the exact --atomic command).

targets.$comment: A RED promotion must prove before == after == current for every canonical target. Otherwise the canonical file changed and it is a promotion-contract violation.

derived_regenerated.$comment: Zone fill, teardrop, length report and fab outputs are derived and regenerated after promotion.

irreversible_side_effects.$comment: Fab RFQ / API calls are logged separately. A file rollback does NOT undo them.

retention.$comment: RED/ERROR/NO_COVERAGE keeps receipt+child+log+scratch. GREEN keeps receipt+hash+summary metric+reproduction command for the audit window.
